definitions.explanation: The same size as the real thing. Used for models, replicas, and reproductions.

examples.japanese: {実物大|じつぶつだい}の{模型|もけい}。
{実物大|じつぶつだい}のガンダムを{見|み}に{行|い}った。
examples.english: I went to see the life-size Gundam.

examples.japanese: {恐竜|きょうりゅう}の{実物大|じつぶつだい}レプリカが{博物館|はくぶつかん}に{展示|てんじ}されている。
examples.english: A full-scale replica of a dinosaur is on display at the museum.

notes:
COLLOCATIONS:
- {実物大|じつぶつだい}の{模型|もけい}: life-size model
- {実物大|じつぶつだい}のレプリカ: full-scale replica

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {原寸大|げんすんだい}: actual size, original size
- {等身大|とうしんだい}: life-size (human-sized); also used figuratively meaning "true to oneself"
